title: Derived internal Hom as a module over the source algebra
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $B$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra. For an $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal F$ the sheaf $\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,\mathcal F)$ is a $B$-module via the action of $B$ on the first argument; the derived extension of this functor $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathrm{Mod}(B)$ is a functor $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,-):D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(B)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra], and for $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ the object $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,K)$ of $D(B)$ is called the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] with its natural $B$-module structure (its image in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ is $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,K)$).
